Need to verify whether micro-cap exceptions RAVE and FARM have sufficient liquidity, reporting quality, and business stability to survive later Serenity layers.

memory_update.text: Restaurants should be tracked as a multi-node system: franchisor royalties, franchisee unit economics, foodservice distribution, private-label beverage inputs, restaurant software, delivery channels, packaging, and kitchen equipment.

The highest-priority underfollowed lanes after Layer 1C are B2B coffee/beverage suppliers, niche franchisors, restaurant software vendors, packaging providers, equipment suppliers, and foodservice distributors rather than mega-cap restaurant operators alone.
Layer 2 must upgrade the candidate universe with primary-source filings, current market caps, analyst coverage, customer concentration, revenue mix, margin pass-through, and liquidity checks.
Micro-cap candidates RAVE and FARM should remain in the speculative-shadow lane until liquidity, customer concentration, reporting quality, and balance-sheet risk are verified.
Franchise royalty streams are only as durable as franchisee returns after labor, rent, food costs, remodel requirements, delivery commissions, and advertising contributions.

summary: Merged Layer 1 restaurant universe emphasizes the Serenity system view: franchisor royalty durability, franchisee unit economics, procurement scale, foodservice distribution, private-label beverage inputs, restaurant SaaS, delivery/ordering infrastructure, packaging, and equipment/remodel bottlenecks. The strongest sourced candidates from the provided Layer 1A/1B evidence are DPZ, DIN, WEN, NATH, RAVE, WEST, FARM, and MIDD. Additional breadth candidates are retained as lower-confidence hypotheses to avoid overfitting to famous restaurant brands before primary-source validation.
universe_method: multi-step: theme decomposition -> node expansion -> dedupe/rank
